hero-subtitle.value: Welcome to my site about skating, art, and gaming

about-me.value: I'm Lumi, a 12-year-old skater and artist. I have skated for two years now, and I have drawn so many pictures of my friends at the skatepark. My board is my favourite thing - I ride it every day after school. I think skating and art are the same thing: you create something new every time. Welcome to my world!

hobby-text-1.value: Skateboarding is my passion. I have skated for two years now. I love the feeling of freedom when I ride. Every day after school, I go to the skatepark with my friends. It is the best part of my day.

hobby-text-2.value: Drawing is my favourite hobby. I have drawn pictures for three years now. I love to draw my friends at the skatepark and my cat Luna. Art makes me happy and calm. When I draw, I feel free.

iterations.prompt: Role: A 12-year-old artist. Context: I have drawn pictures for three years. Task: Write a short paragraph about my art. Format: One paragraph.
iterations.draft: Drawing is my favourite hobby. I have drawn pictures for three years. I like to draw my friends and animals.
iterations.edited: Drawing is my favourite hobby. I have drawn pictures for three years now. I love to draw my friends at the skatepark and my cat Luna. Art makes me happy and calm. When I draw, I feel free.
iterations.reason: The text was boring, so I added my cat Luna and the skatepark to make it personal

hobby-text-3.value: Gaming is fun. I have played games for five years. I like racing games the most. They are fast and exciting. My favourite game is Rocket Kart because I can build my own tracks.
